newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Aluminium/Attica says 96 turnover up 24pct.
newsitem.headline: Greek Aluminium/Attica says 96 turnover up 24pct.

text.p: Greek metallurgical firm Aluminium of Attica said in a statement that its 1996 turnover rose 24 percent to 3.1 billion drachmas from 2.5 billion in 1995.
The firm said it expected 1997 turnover to increase to 3.7 billion drachmas.
The firm estimated 1996 pretax profits of 3.387 billion drachmas from 3.4 billion in 1995, its chief financial officer, Nikitas Voutsas told Reuters.

Voutsas said profit from industrial activities rose to 370 million drachmas in 1996 from 302 million in 1995, participations also rose to 417 million drachmas from 196 million in 1996 but portfolio capital gains fell to 2.6 billion from 2.9 billion in 1995.
The general shareholders' meeting on Tuesday also gave the green light for an increase in the firm's share capital by 3.567 billion drachmas to 4.659 billion, it said.
The share capital increase will result from a fourfold increase in the nominal price of each share and the capitalisation of reserves, it said.
